scientific_integrity: Sharp norm equality follows from analytical jump superposition and retained-knot lower semicontinuity; the sub-micro-unit numeric enclosure uses exact integers plus an analytical remainder, without claiming an elementary closed form.
scientific_limitations: Only real bi-infinite data of finite discrete total variation and the uniform dyadic four-point scheme for 0 <= omega < 1/8.
Original 1987 paper and 1988 author report have earlier month-level archival records; the cited 2008-10-07 date is the earliest day-verified archival lead used, not the origin date of the scheme.
Historical priority remains qualified by unavailable full text of the original 1987 article.
title: Sharp bounded-variation stability of the four-point subdivision limit
